University of Gothenburg, Aasaaska Naxwaha Afka Soomaaliga: Xallinta Layliyada Buugga 1aad (2023), p. 88: raadin jiray; Radio Sweden Somali (26 Nov 2019): lagu raadin jiray; Qaamuuska Af-Soomaaliga (2012), p. 702: raadi f.g2 (-iyay, -isay)

note: Judge agreement only when both the main-verb infinitive and the jir auxiliary are exact reviewed surfaces. The main verb is non-finite in this construction; the auxiliary carries person/number/gender agreement. Unknown or differently typed main-verb forms and auxiliaries remain unjudged. Exact iibsan and raadin are individually attested reviewed stems; no Class-II/Class-III infinitive generation is licensed. Gothenburg tone marks are retained as evidence and are not silently normalized into analyzer surfaces.
